Store Championship events bring the excitement, prestige, and prizing of Regionals to select local gaming stores!
Check the below to learn more and find one near you!
Aim to become the Card Game Pirate King starting from here!
*Finals Invites are only awarded to North America and Europe TCG+ accounts.
*Some selected stores will be offered events for more than 64 players.
*Survey Available at Bandai TCG＋ Manager Web
*After this period, selected stores are able to apply for the event.
*Please also join official discord server for further support.
NA September 4 at 5pm Pacific/8pm Eastern - September 14 at 5pm Pacific/8pm Eastern
EU September 4 at 5pm GMT +0 - September 14 at 5pm GMT +0
*Players will be selected by a random selection if the number of applicants exceeds the event capacity.
Depending on the store, advance payment may be required. If so, stores may change a player's BANDAI TCG+ status to "Waitlist" if payment is not completed by the specified deadline.
Please check with the store regarding accepted payment methods and deadlines.
Payment arrangements are handled directly between players and stores. Bandai is not responsible for payment-related matters and cannot accommodate refund requests or similar inquiries.
The location and the date of each Store Championship will be listed in TCG+ before player applications open.
Players can search for a store near them and apply to it through TCG+!
OPCG Booster Pack(s) *Each Booster volume varies by store.
Regionals Finalist Card Set vol.2 x1
CS26-27 Regionals Season 2 Top 16 Alt-Art Card x1
Invites to the Championship Finals Season 2 will be given out to the top players based on actual participation numbers as follows.
The booster pack(s) provided as participation prizes will not be supplied by BANDAI and must be prepared independently by each store.
For official ONE PIECE CARD GAME events, stores are required to provide booster pack(s) in accordance with the participation fee charged.
For more information please check the Terms and Conditions below.

Each store has the authority to determine how to notify players and collect payments. Be sure to clearly indicate payment method, deadline, and the stores refund policy to the [Successful] Status players.
Stores can re-select players from the top of the waitlist if there are [Successful] Status players who haven’t made the payment by the deadline specified by the store.
The tournament will be held in accordance with the Official Rules on the official website.
Please read the Official Rules and FAQ carefully before participating.

*If you have any questions about the rules during a battle, or if you have any doubts about whether or not something is correct, please raise your hand immediately and ask for a decision from the "staff" and follow their ruling. Please note that correct judgments cannot be made after the battle has progressed.
*Cards that are not legitimate, such as photocopied cards, cannot be used.
All images, text and data on this website may not be reproduced without permission.
Please note that the images used on this website may differ from the actual product as it is still under development.
